## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Kusalattika, Vedanāttika* (Patthana 11.1) is a text of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka located in the Paṭṭhāna collection. It comprises the first triad combination (*tika*) combining the Wholesome Triad (*kusalattika*) with the Feeling Triad (*vedanāttika*) [Nyanatiloka 2007]. Its opening section on conditioning by dependency (*paṭicca-vāra*) articulates permutations such as: "Dependent on a wholesome (unwholesome, or neutral) phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling, there may arise a wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling, conditioned by way of root" [Nyanatiloka 2007].
